status: REFERENCE ONLY - not wired into the harness; see the decision log entry of 2026-11-08
label_window: Chloe's: default in [1 Jun fs_year+1, 31 May fs_year+2]; rows defaulted before 1 Jun fs_year+1 excluded
pipeline: PD = clip(expit(anchor_a + slope_b*logit(p_raw) + delta), floor, cap)
slope_b_source: round-1 Platt slope on FY2008 (model fit on FY2007); a production-specific slope needs an out-of-time slice for the 2007-2011 model, which does not exist; clean-slice check slope in fit_and_map_params.json
anchor_a_procedure: solve anchor_a so that mean(expit(anchor_a + slope_b*logit(p_raw))) over the 835,016 training rows equals training_rate_assumed (bisection, as solve_shift in s3_methods.py). Needs the production model's in-sample raw PDs on its training rows, which were not handed over; compute once at estimation time.
tau_rule: D-073 logic: expected rate h=2 years after the FY2011 anchor under a driftless logit random walk
replaces: her Platt calibrator fitted on pooled round 1-3 out-of-time raw PDs (default rate 1.536%, mean raw PD 1.105%, manifest calibration_raw_metrics); applying that intercept to a model refit on those same years double-counts the level (D-053 alternative b)
